verdict.rationale: Visa documents spending limits and mandates for agent payments. The Purchase Intent API requires a declineThreshold amount and an effectiveUntilTime expiry, VisaNet enforces network-level controls on merchant and amount, and agents can cancel a purchase intent. These caps are scoped to each purchase-intent mandate rather than being standing per-agent budgets, and revocation is shown only as cancelling an intent; agent-token 'life cycle management' is claimed without a documented suspend/delete call, and the product is flagged as still in development. Missing for 10: per-agent standing spend caps, usage/frequency limits, an explicit instant token-revocation API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
